reviews.title: Rarely on time
reviews.text: I bought tickets on TAP as I was traveling to both Portugal and Morocco and they had reasonably priced Economy Plus tickets. I thought I’d give them a try as they allow skip lagging. They left SFO to Lisbon an hour late, then they left Lisbon to Casablanca 40 minutes late ( for a 30 minute flight) and then they left Casablanca to Lisbon 2 hours late!!! The only flight they made on time was my return from Lisbon to SFO, and we arrived 45 minutes early! The crew was very nice and helpful, however their airport staff in both Lisbon and Casablanca were not helpful. I won’t fly them again.
reviews.author: trvlvr102155

reviews.title: Economy Class within Business Class
reviews.text: While the flight was cheaper than others, we got what we paid for. Booked Business Class to Lisbon with a short layover to Barcelona. Their business or Executive Class was subpar to others. We were very cramped, with little storage area for accessories. I ran out of leg room when lying flat and could not easily adjust my position while sleeping. It felt claustrophobic. The food was terrible. The next leg was nightmarish. They advertised it being also business class but it was not. We were last ones allowed on the plane, but needless to say all overhead storage was already taken above our row #2.
reviews.author: Robert D

reviews.title: Baggage scam!
reviews.text: My wife and I just completed a wonderful 3 week vacation in Spain, Italy and Morocco. We flew on TAP from SFO to Lisbon and then to Seville. We checked 1 bag cost 150$. Upon returning we traveled the exact same way back, but this time a little surprise awaited us. TAP Airlines calls it "baggage control" At the TAP gate! in Lisbon we had to have carry on luggage weighed. We were told that we are only allowed carry on kilos per person. Our total carry on was 28 kilos, we were forced to pay at the gate 165 euros to check an additional bag! They must have nailed at least 40 passengers with that scam. Shame on you TAP! NO WONDER YOU'RE IN BANKRUPTCY! WILL NEVER FLY YOUR AIRLINES AGAIN!
reviews.author: Mark S

reviews.title: Lost my luggage and had my flight cancelled , abandoned in the airport for 12 hours.
reviews.text: TAPair are the worst airline I have ever flown with. from start to finish it was a shambles. Complete lack of professionalism at every level particularly in Portugal but even in the UK. They took our hand luggage from us at Lisbon, failing to scan it meaning there was no possibility of locating it or connecting to our baggage or receipts. I want to also add that our hand luggage was taken even though being at least 2kg under and we were the first in line for the plane, the holds were pretty much empty. They put us in the plane and after an hour of sitting on the tarmac they cancelled the flight. We then waited 2 hours 30 minutes to be told anything. We were given no water while we waited and there was no communication. We then we’re told they were putting us on separate flights the next day. The first one being 7:40, which was the flight my family and I were getting on. We were then told to make our way to baggage claim/lost and found. My question was why on earth would our luggage be going to lost and found? After waiting over an hour at lost an found where we were met with nothing but hostility and rudeness , we decided to move on and find a pet of the airport to call home for 12 hours. They refused to even find the luggage after telling them multiple times there was life saving medication in the cases for my grandmother and my mother. That is inhumane and cruel. Given that we are now in 2023 you would’ve thought that they would’ve been able to connect our luggage with each flight that different people left Portugal on the next day. But when we eventually landed in Heathrow, we then waited ages to speak to a representative of TAPair only to be sent on a wild goose chase the same way we were sent around at Lisbon airport. When we got to the checking in area at Heathrow which was where we were sent to track the luggage, the staff scanned our luggage receipts, and there was no record on the system of our luggage. They failed to do the most basic task in Portugal of scanning our hand luggage that was taken away from us may I add. One of the women that went through the whole ordeal with us had an AirTag in her hand luggage and it was showing that the luggage hadn’t even left Portugal. After being abandoned in the airport for 12 hours and losing my whole family’s luggage I can assure you this is not an airline you want to fly with. Problems occur a lot when flying but never to this extent and I have flown with multiple airlines and I’ve never ever had this problem. The whole of TAPair whether that’s the check in staff, the ground staff, the crew members have no idea what customer service is and are rude and obnoxious and do not care for their customers. I urge you not to book with this company if you value your belongings, your sleep, your money, your sanity and your blood pressure
reviews.author: K M

reviews.title: Very comfortable and new plane
reviews.text: Our group of six adults flew round trip, direct, from Miami to Lisbon, and it was a nice experience. Particularly flying from Lisbon back to Miami. The seats were actually pretty comfortable, plenty of food and drinks were served. Food was good. Huge plane, and very new. On our flight to Europe it got pretty hot on board, and you can’t control your own air. But on the way home, it was much better monitored, and plenty cool. The crew was pleasant and attentive. TVs all worked well. Our friend had to cancel and she spent a couple of months trying to get a refund, which was frustrating, so we were worried we would all have a bad experience. Not at all. We even had to call customer service at one point to fix an error in our tickets, and the call was answered quickly and our reservation fixed within minutes. I suspect the airline is trying very hard to undo the negative reputation it earned during and after Covid. I can honestly say that I would book that flight again.
reviews.author: Donna P

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY—LUGGAGE LOST FOREVER
reviews.text: I flew from Lisbon to Newark on June 30, 2022 and TAP lost three of my five luggages. Since I did not have internet service at the airport and could not file the required PIR claim, the TAP representative at Newark’s baggage claim offered to file the report on my behalf. Well, he never did and I was unable to do so when I got home because TAP’s website said my bag tags did not exist. Every time I called (I once racked up a $90 Verizon wireless international charge for a phone number TAP said was toll free), or emailed, TAP continued to ask for the PIR I was unable to get. Most suspiciously, three and four months after my trip, respectively, two of my three lost luggages were returned (I had to go to Newark to pick them up) using the information I labeled each bag with. One year later, however, the bag with my most valuable possessions is still missing and TAP continues to cite the lack of a PIR claim as the reason they cannot assist me. DO NOT FLY TAP BECAUSE YOU MAY NEVER GET YOUR LUGGAGE BACK AND THEY WILL FAIL TO ASSIST YOU IN ANY REASONABLE MANNER NOR OFFER COMPENSATION FOR THEIR ERRORS.
reviews.author: Sophia + Matt

reviews.title: Acts like budget, costs much more
reviews.text: TAP is the worst flight experience I've had, and this includes random African regional airlines. -Allowed us to check in luggage for free on one leg, then charged on the next (without any indication of charges until the gate). Fighting this charge currently, as I found this extremely deceitful. -staff acts like they are doing you a favor, both on the ground and in the air. For my return flight, I asked a question about checking my luggage (knowing full well what had happened before) and they responded tersely before walking away as if I had offended her. -Speaking of the above, TAP can only check luggage in for a flight out of Madrid 2 hours in advance - when it is advised to be at the airport 2-3 hours early + there being announcements that US-bound individuals should be at the boarding gate 2 hours early. I will pay additional money and take on layovers to avoid ever traveling on TAP portugal again.
reviews.author: Jacob E

reviews.title: MUST READ REVIEW - SAVE YOURSELF - DON'T CHOOSE TAPAIR
reviews.text: This is the worst Airline i have ever dealt with. After purchasing a flight ticket directly from their website and then completed web Check-In i came to the airport knowing all i need to do is to send my luggages. Shockingly! the ladies at the check in informed me that there is an issue with my ticket and right now i'm blocked in their system (at that point it's 3 hours before departure) Blocked? why? i paid full price, the money was already deducted from my bank account and even managed to complete the check-in online and chose seats. After they sent me to talk with so many people, eventually they DIDN'T ACCEPT me as a passenger because I DIDN'T PURCHASE A RETURN TICKET THROUGH THEM AS WELL. Can you believe it? you probably thinking right now that the airline's right because many countries won't let you in without a ticket out of the country - BUT I HAD A TICKET OUT! i bought it from a different airline and showed them a receipt! but they said i had to buy it through them. (wasn't mentioned anywhere when i bought the tickets) They said they're sorry that's their policy and they will refund me. I'M STILL CHASING THEM FOR MY MONEY UNTIL NOW! When i'm calling they're telling me "use our website services to request a refund," through the website it says contact our support team. never ending back and forth. This is a nightmare, I hope by sharing with you guys my experience at least you won't have to go through what i did.
reviews.author: dansr95

reviews.title: STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS
reviews.text: RED FLAG, they made me check in my carry on bag... Here comes the nightmare: My flight from Newark to Lisbon was delayed by 2 hours which made me lose my connection from Lisbon to Rome. My connection from Lisbon to Rome was suppose to depart at 7 am and they assigned a flight until 8 pm! After long lines, total chaos at customer service , many people angry and desperate trying to change their new flights, they finally assigned me a new flight at 1 pm. This 1 pm flight was delayed 1.5 hours as well, I ended up arriving at 8 pm. The top everything off , they lost our luggage!!! I was in Rome without anything at all for 2 days !!!! sinc
reviews.author: Marvin Flores-Todd

reviews.title: The worst experience I’ve ever had on an airline.
reviews.text: Truly such a shameful experience on all levels. Terrible gate agents, customer service, and value. To start our experience, we paid to choose our seats (4 of us) 2 months prior to the flight. During check in we were handed our boarding passes, and the airline had changed us to the very last row of the plane. They told us we could pay YET AGAIN to pick our seats, but they wouldn’t be honoured. They basically take your money in the blink of an eye, then deny you the basic service you paid for, and they also refused to issue a refund for the paid seats. They basically want to make it such an intolerable situation for their customers that they don’t even bother, and the airline can just continue to scam. We were ensured by the check in agent that our carry on baggage was approved, and it was weighed to be the proper weight under company policy. Therefore, we were quadruple assured that all our delicate valuables could travel in our carry on. Fast forward to boarding, the gate agent attempted to deny ALL of our carry ons. She refused to acknowledge the company policy that we willingly brought up on our phone, proving we were within the stated limitations. She proceeded to become violent, and threaten to deny us boarding after a coworker of her tried to intervene and tell her there was nothing wrong with the carry ons. After her scene, we let her tag the bags to be “checked”. We proceeded to simply walk on board with our carry on bags and stow them in the above compartment with no issue, on a half filled flight. We had two separate flights on this airline the same day. One from Venice to Lisbon. Then another from Lisbon to Toronto. Both were equally painful and absolutely intolerable. A completely despicable company that I would never recommend to anyone. Just don’t bother travelling at all if it’s your only option.
reviews.author: Faith J

reviews.title: Put me off the flight
reviews.text: So from alicante to lisboa we came 1 hour to late and my next flight was still reachable but they simply put me off the flight they gave me 12€… now I have to go to Milan and then to Luxemburg they stole my whole day worst company I have ever seen I buy a Flight and they give me something completely different i would rate 0 if possible unserious company
reviews.author: Mihran N

reviews.title: Unbelievable!
reviews.text: Due to a late departure from LHR, I missed my onward connection to Seville from Lisbon. I could not fly until the next day and arrived 9 hrs late. I applied for compensation in hope rather than expectation...... and was flabbergasted to receive an email 12 mins later awarding me the maximum €400 either as a voucher or payment into my bank account. Couldn't ask for more!!
reviews.author: David C

reviews.title: Don't waste your money on business class
reviews.text: The two rows of business class had the exact same chairs used in economy!!!! The food was terrible with stale tart and bread. Worst of all the ponta Delgada airport has not opened its lounge since COVID!!!! What an excuse! There is no flight entertainment.
reviews.author: Elie S

reviews.title: Some good, some frustrating , some deceitfulness
reviews.text: This airline has some good, some frustrating things about it. But there is one defining element that will have me never fly with them again. I checked 2 bags total. The way the company handled the situation I was deceitfully charged for 3 checked bags. Many employees at the airport told us they would refund our overcharge amount but when we requested the refund and supplied proof for this overcharge we were told by TAP they will not be refunding our overcharge. So a company that deceitfully plays games, makes up overcharges and stands by that… never will I fly with an immoral company like that again. The reason one flys with this company in the first place is the cost, but you end up spending more then normal airlines due to these hidden, made up fees and it’s done in an infuriating manner. I will just fly with companies that I know what I will pay and are honorable and honest.
reviews.author: Richie W

reviews.title: Just don’t. Really don’t.
reviews.text: Ryan sue and easy jet have better service, are more punctual have MORE LEGROOM and are substantially cheaper. This airline is run by incompetent menaces. Just do yourself a favor and stay away at any cost
reviews.author: Peter F

reviews.title: Worst communication & Website
reviews.text: While the flight in and of itself was fine, the communication was miserable and continues to be after 9 weeks and still trying to resolve an issue. I purchased RT, they had me appear as a No Show on a flight out the next day so had to buy another one way ticket to get home, which was the same price as the RT. The website was not working, AGAIN, so i was forced to purchase on the phone which increased the fare despite the fact that the website wouldn't allow you to book. I've been emailing and calling intensely for 9 weeks and no one will respond. To. date the website is still wonky.
reviews.author: Ali Bi

reviews.title: Guaranteed to lose bags
reviews.text: I dont know if it's TAP's issue or Groundforce, but we took multiple airines on our trip from US to Portugal (Iberia and TAP), and all times Groundforce were the baggage handlers and all times we never got our bags. I had to spend 2 hrs at the airport 3 different days during our vacation to collect our bags that came on later flights. Advice to other travelers is to ensure you take a carry on with some clothes and supplies for a day as these European airlines handles by Groundforce are guaranteed to lose your bags.
reviews.author: Dhiraj Gadia

reviews.title: Don't fly TAP airline Portugese!!!
reviews.text: We have purchased 1pm flight from Lisbon, Portugal to Seville, Spain (3 tickets cost us 675.45 EUR) which out of three flights available on the 15th June 2023 was the most expensive flight, more than double the price of any of the two other flights. The other two flights at 7.25am and 10.25pm, were inconvenient. On 26 May 2023, TAP airline informed us, via email, of the cancellation of our 1pm flight. We were given options of the two other flights, 7.25am or 10.25pm. 10.25pm flight on the day we were advised of cancellation would cost us around 314 EUR for 3 tickets. The difference in price of 362 EUR was not even mentioned in the TAP email. I am still fighting with the TAP airline for the refund and I would add to the above mentioned amount 50 EUR we charged for the late check in in Seville. In addition, we demand compensation for all this stress and inconveniences caused by TAP. Their response when we managed to speak to them on the phone was "Wait for our email, it is still "Under analysis". This "customer service" is unacceptable!! Charging much more for a flight and then bumping down to a cheaper flight, without refund difference is unethical and unprofessional. I was expecting more from a Portugese airline.
reviews.author: LoraMelbourne

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: The worst company I ever dealt with!!! Customer service doesn't exist..... if you do get to talk to someone noone can help they don't know anything and just hang up the phone on you We had soo Many problems on our holiday from the airplane to missing items form the luggage and no customer service ...
reviews.author: Zzzzzzzzz123

reviews.title: A company that lies to their costumers
reviews.text: My fiancé and I had booked a flight with TAP and I will never make that mistake ever again. This was over 7 months ago. The flight had a layover. The first flight was delayed for over 3 hours and therefore, we had to spend the night in Lisbon. We were told we will get reimbursed for the airport taxi back and forth and the hotel for the night. After submitting the complaint, they never got back to me. Forever the complaint was on pending status and suddenly and became completed but they never reached out to me and I never got my money back. After trying to reaching out to their customer service- 2 months ago, they’ve said the complaint department will reach out to me but they never did. Now the customer service doesn’t answer my messages, and i still never heard back from them.
reviews.author: Yoni Shaked

reviews.title: Dreadful airline but Good help at call service helpline
reviews.text: We booked our flight 4 months before holiday date for 4 people in a group. At Lisbon only 1 of our group was allowed to board and three of us were put on standby. To cut a long story short the flight was. Rearranged and we were given €700 x2 voucher for denial of boarding. Yesterday we tried to book a holiday to Prague using the vouchers for the same 4 people. You guessed it the vouchers didn’t work so after an hour long phone call we were emailed new vouchers which did work. BUT when we booked the new flight simultaneously on two devices both booking allocated the wrong flight so instead of a 5.5 hour journey we were allocated an 11hour + trip. So back on the phone to the call helpline and after 2 hours 11 minutes on the phone my booking was changed but we had to pay €30 between us for the privilege of correcting their error. ( this seemed beneficial, rather than 7 hours waiting at Lisbon airport) HOWEVER there is some good news the gentleman that helped me on the phone really couldn’t have done more to help and with such a lovely attitude. I think the mans name was Hudson. The number I called was 00351211234400. I will never fly TAP again.
reviews.author: Moira

reviews.title: The worst airline
reviews.text: The worst airline company I have ever flown with. Flights are always delayed. There isn't any support for transit passengers at Lisbon airport, staff ignores passengers. I don't recommend dealing with this company.
reviews.author: Tetiana

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: Change gate 20 minutes before boarding, no announcement. Rude staff, no customer service. Worst airline I have ever dealt with, will never fly TAP ever again. Trashy company.
reviews.author: Esther C

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: My wife was just diagnosed with terminal cancer and I called asking for a refund. every other carrier, hotel and tour on this trip to Italy fully refunded with no cancellation fees. TAP told me they needed a death certificate before they would consider a refund. disgusting.
reviews.author: john p

reviews.title: Dublin to Madeira disaster
reviews.text: We left home at 6.30am for a flight to Madeira via Lisbon, the flight from Dublin was delayed and we arrived in Lisbon with barely enough time to catch Funchal flight (should have been almost 3 hours in Lisbon) we then sat on aircraft for quite some time, eventually we took off and an hour and a half later we arrived but couldn't land because of high wind, we circled for 30 minutes then had to return to Lisbon, we were told ground staff would organise new boarding cards, we queued for two and a half hours and were given boarding card for the next morning, we arrived at hotel at midnight without luggage, we didn't even have a hairbrush, and we were starving, next day up at 6.00 am went to airport to see message that we would be given info at 10.30, we boarded the flight about noon and same again we sat on runway for a while then flew to Funchal and circled for an hour then flew back to Lisbon, queued again for 2 hours and told them we couldn't do it again, we are in our mid seventies and we were exhausted, we did not get our luggage back until 8.45pm, the flights were cancelled by Tap but because we had travelled from Dublin they would not cancel the Dublin return, the rep told us just to phone and tell them we couldn't use them which I did. I filled in the refund claim and got a refund of £374 on a flight which cost £1000! how does this work? Last time I tried to fly to Madeira on a TAP flight it was cancelled because of covid and they never refunded the cost, I did get it in the end from Credit Card Company! will I never learn. This trip was for our 50th wedding anniversary and we lost three days in total and were absolutely exhausted.
reviews.author: betty A

reviews.title: Horrible service and shortest flight became longer worst nightmare
reviews.text: Me and my wife were flying to malaga connecting via lisbon 1st class. We did not get any emails or texts from Tap but when we got to airport there was a 7 hour delay. Then we missed not 1 but 2 connecting flights when we could have made the 2nd but they wouldn't hold the plane for a few minutes, leaving us stranded an additional 9 hours. I picked this for shortest flight of 11 hours that suddenly became nearly 30. We arrived 1145pm and lost my rental car and paid 2x for another rental company and lost 1 day of the hotel fee, and they refused to reimburse me for my losses despite the evidence given and time wasted emailing them. Ironic at the airport someone else was there saying don't waste your time and she was right.
reviews.author: ajghods

reviews.title: The man who was the boss for serving drinks and meal was rude, racist and ill mannered.
reviews.text: I should have known from the first moment he saw me he was not going to be nice to me. He had an amazing greeting for the female passenger on my left in the window seat 6A. I got 6B. The man on my right, was treated like a King and he had ordered special meal. They both got excellent service. Me, he was so obnoxious and just looked at me when serving drinks expecting me to tell him what I would like to drink. I asked what he had and he rudely started to list everything even when I made my choice at tomato juice, he continued with his list. The man beside me got the royal treatment again. At meal service time, he incorrectly told the girl beside me chicken instead of beef then looked at me and I told him beef is my choice. I asked for water. He grabbed the water from the nearby storage and then just walked away without giving me any. Upon his return to pick up the trays I asked again and a few moments later he came back with it and walked away saying sorry. I've never been treated so badly on an airplane by a steward in my life before. He should get more training and learn how to deal with peoples of all nationalities and colour. I will never travel TAP again! The plane was also a small one for such a long haul flight to Toronto, Canada. Luckily I had a good seat in 6B as a Star Alliance member. That was a pleasant surprise.
reviews.author: aquafeb2003

reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs. It would be better to fly into Madrid or Paris then fly with TAP Air direct. The worst customer service and severely overpriced. Poor booking experience couple with weight restrictions for carry ons even in business class. The priority lounge is stacked with 20 other airlines in a tiny lounge that is booked to capacity and 10 degrees hotter than the rest of the airport. To top it off the flight is delayed daily by an hour or two. Avoid at all costs not worth it. By far the worst airline experience Ive ever had.
reviews.author: James W

reviews.title: Every trip they have ruined...plane delays and lost baggage are too common fraudulent inducement at its best
reviews.text: A seriously terrible airline. They lie constantly. I have never engaged with such a disgusting company in my life. The cabin crew are also bad, the’ve been rude by English standards, abrupt and have no manners even by Dutch standards. The first flight we boarded late, they made up some lie about a sick passenger when in fact I could see them still fuelling up and loading and they certainly were not helping a sick passenger who had somehow mysteriously boarded the plane early and needed attention. We then were stuck on the plane for an additional two hours and 55 minutes before we took off after three hours..but the plane was slowly rolling around before the three hour time limit so they could avoid refund claims.. In this period we were denied water by the cabin crew, who were also very rude and the air conditioning wasn't running yet so it was really hot and stuffy. Another flight attendant on another flight directly lied to me, while looking me in the eyes after he had just made a fake phone call to “see” if my bag was loaded onto the plane. He promised it was…it wasn't it was backed up in a basement in Schiphol. In Lisbon TAP closed down all its offices and refused to help the many customers it had stranded or whose baggage they had lost. They even closed the lost and found After 10 months of emails they still haven't completed the refund process to cover the cost I had to incur due to them losing baggage and they always respond with the same lies…Even though they have admitted on multiple occasions I can receive a refund or flight points they always manage to find an excuse not to do it.
reviews.author: Review account

reviews.title: Just don't book it
reviews.text: Avoid like a plague, in case flight is cancel you won't see the new one in a days. They made us wait for 12h in airpoort without solution, told us we are going to recieve SMS with new flight details, that never happened. Did I mention that I'm 4 months pregnant?
reviews.author: LuLu

reviews.title: The worst customer experience I’ve ever experienced. No holidays and minus 500+€ on my bank account.
reviews.text: I’m so disappointed. I have booked with TAP a 1 week trip to Madeira. The morning of the flight scheduled I received an email from TAP saying that my outbound flight changed to 4 days later (return ticket stayed the same). I called them and they told me that the change happened due to weather conditions and that they didn’t have earlier flights. I cancelled the car rental, the hotel, taxis with no full refunds since I cancelled with a less than 24 hour notice. This morning I checked online to see that the flight I was going to be in, LANDED with 1hour delay. I called them and they said that they THOUGHT the flight would get cancelled but in the end IT DIDN’T!!!! not only that but there are flights happening today and I asked if they can put me in these flights but they declined, saying that I need to book via their website. The seats available are not economy, only business so they cost more than 1300€ I also wanted to mentioned that on their website, the process of making complaints and refunds is difficult and extremely time consuming. I have never experience such a bad service as a customer. I have been stressed for 2 days dealing with them, I lost money, my holidays are ruined and they don’t even help you find alternative solutions even though it was their mistake. HORRIBLE
reviews.author: Marykapp

reviews.title: Always late
reviews.text: After a flight from Dubai, I had to wait for Lisbon /Porto as a connection flight, and AGAIN the flights were delay. I refuse to flight by TAP, unfortunately company booked. There's not a single time, no matter from where or to where that TAP doesn't delay flights. One time, my daughter with a baby, waited 5 hours for a flight Lisbon / Porto. At the end, she decided to rent a car to do travel. No one is capable to present solutions to this continuous problems!!!
reviews.author: Patricia M

reviews.title: Worst experience of all my time flying
reviews.text: We a family of 5 suffered getting back home. To return on the 21st, did not see home till the 23rd due to delays that were as long as 6 hrs and cancellations by this airline for our connecting flights. What was supposed to be a quick layover in Lisbon for a connection straight to Chicago, turned into a nightmare leaving us in Lisbon for the night, then having to connect in Miami the next day, but first not being able to leave on time making us get there at night vs day as we were supposed to, having to stay in Miami for the night. The next morning, the last connecting flight was never confirmed by them and only finding out at 3am when we went to check in with the other airline that they "booked" us with for the final flight. Then when they did book us a new later flight with yet another airline, they left out my youngest daughter... You can imagine how frustrated, angry, emotionally stressed and exhausted we all were by day 3 of dealing with this airline. They could not figure out what was wrong with my daughter's ticket and would not cancel it to simply reissue it because according to them we would have to pay for that. Let me tell you that the United agent who I wish I had gotten and remembered her name (shame on me) saw our state and condition and me as a mother not having a ticket for my youngest jumped in to help when she didn't have to given it was not United's doing. That woman made a miracle some how getting through to TAP's helpline and getting them to release the ticket, that woman was our savior and wish I could have shown her my gratitude which is beyond words. We plan on going back to Europe in the future but never ever again with this airline and you bet I've already let others know. We reached out to the airline for the compensation owed to each according to the European law, but no one has reached out since, not once.
reviews.author: Sarah R

reviews.title: Bad plane
reviews.text: Food was disgusting and overpriced plane journey was very violent kept spinning every second was very bad and shaky would never recommend again as it felt very unsafe and thought my life was gonna end food was absolutely horrendous nearly threw up
reviews.author: Maria A

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs. They scam your money
reviews.text: I have been all over the world and I have flew in a lot of different companies and it is the first time they charge you for carrying personal item . They made a whole set up right at the boarding area, where people would not see or have access, and they brought two scales and they would make the passengers weight their carry-on luggage . When the weight of the carry-on wasn’t enough to charge us a fee, they would make us add our personal purse on top. They would claim it passed 1kg extra (it was showing in lbs weight but I guess it is easier to confuse people using a different number). And from there they asked us of 125 euros on fee. I have never seen in my life any company charging for personal purse weight, or asking to add that weight to the carry on luggage. I asked her many times why she was doing that and she completely ignored my question and would only say “they both passed the weight and you gotta pay a fee” I paid but I am getting my money back through my credit card company, that is completely illegal to do.
reviews.author: T R

reviews.title: TAP is a scam.
reviews.text: They extort you for $125 Euro if you have a bag weighing over 12kg, even if you have a bag included in your ticket. Never fly TAP.
reviews.author: john p

reviews.title: Cannot check in cos of mandatory field
reviews.text: Frustrated! Trying to check in, go through the process, decided to change to a paid seat. When it comes to paying it asks for contact details ie email address which I put in and it keeps saying I need to complete the mandatory field. WHICH I HAVE DOZENS OF TIMES. reviews.title: Luggage Nightmare on TAP Portugal Air
reviews.text: This was the worst airline service I have ever experienced. They scam you and make you pay for carry-on luggage. I flew from New York to Lisbon and it took forever to board. I had a carry-on and a backpack. When I was about to board at the gate for my return flight to NYC two TAP agents started weighing every single passenger's hand luggage and charging €125 on the spot. I felt scammed, having to pay €125 for a carry-on bag that I use on every other airline. Unscrupulous practice. Btw gate was barricaded with tall wall so you could not see what was happening until you went to their passport control. This situation is unconscionable and a sneaky money grab.
reviews.author: Love-to-travel2201

reviews.title: Flight cancelled.
reviews.text: Arrived at Heathrow at 5.30am on 10th May to fly to Lisbon for our honeymoon and were told that our flight had been cancelled. No prior warning or explanation. Had to book into a hotel until the next flight which was eleven hours later. Cost us a whole day of our honeymoon. Never again.
reviews.author: Tom P

reviews.title: TAP Air Portugal gate luggage scam for every passenger boarding plane
reviews.text: Actually, it was the worst airline service I have ever experienced. I went out of my way to write this review in the hope that people will avoid this terrible airline. I flew from Miami to Lisbon and it took forever to board. The food was also horrible, by the way. I had a carry-on and a backpack. When I flew to Madeira Island, there were no issues because I paid for the carry-on on easyjet. Today flying from Funchal to Lisbon no issues on TAP with luggage. However, when I was about to board at the gate for my return flight to MIA, two TAP agents started weighing every single passenger's hand luggage and charging €125 on the spot. It was the same bag I had brought from Miami. I felt scammed, having to pay €125 for a carry-on bag that I use on every other airline. Unscrupulous practice. Btw gate was barricaded with tall wall so you could not see what was happening until you went to their passport control. This situation is unconscionable. Comfort level 1. Food 1. Btw bins are 50% empty now because of this unscrupulous practice.
reviews.author: miamiblonde

reviews.title: Avoid at any cost
reviews.text: My plan for the summer of 2022 was to spend time in Lisbon with my family, but TAP airline made sure those plans were thwarted. I traveled ahead of my sons but when they were at the gate ready to board the plane they were turned away, apparently due to an overbooked flight. They received no assistance at the airport, TAP did not offer alternative travel and although we spent an entire weekend trying to get help it was all to no avail. A year later we have not been reimbursed nor have we gotten any compensation from TAP, despite repeated efforts. Customer service is appalling and feedback has been nonexistent. Our intended two weeks together turned into a lonely visit to Portugal for myself. Please do avoid TAP if possible, or else make sure your travel insurance covers all and any form of disruption.
reviews.author: Halldor

reviews.title: TAP refuses reimbursement in cash
reviews.text: I've asked for a reimbursement of my tickets in cash but got vouchers. More than 3 months later and after several long calls to TAP costumer service I haven't received my reimbursement in cash. But no one seems to care at TAP.
reviews.author: VS067

reviews.title: Journey Through unbeatable Maze that is TAP Air Customer Service
reviews.text: If you've ever had the dream (or nightmare) of being a character in a surreal novel, let me recommend booking a flight with TAP Air. The level of incompetence they display with basic booking changes is something Salvador Dali would appreciate, but the average traveler...not so much. Now, here's my anecdote: I booked a round-trip journey. Outbound, Discount Fare, no checked bag; inbound, Executive Fare with two complimentary checked bags. All quite simple, right? But ah, my friends, this is where the plot thickens. You see, I own a small pet dog - the perfect companion for any journey. So, I thought to myself, "Why not trade these two checked bags for the company of my canine companion?" Ah, such naive optimism... The journey through TAP Air’s customer service labyrinth began. I approached their customer service like a brave explorer venturing into unknown territories. Alas, each call was more perplexing than the last. It seemed as though their computer systems were concocted by a whimsical Mad Hatter, where "no checked bag" is synonymous with "two checked bags" and "one small dog" translates to "Absolutely not!" It's almost impressive how such a simple request turned into an epic saga. I imagined their booking systems as a mystical beast, lurking in the shadows, snarling at any hint of change or logical requests. Don't get me wrong, TAP Air could be a splendid choice if you're a fan of adventure, particularly if your idea of adventure involves wrestling with paradoxical customer service and battling the hydra of unhelpful booking systems. But alas, if you're like me and merely want a hassle-free flight with your fluffy companion, you might find yourself barking up the wrong tree with TAP Air. Rating: 1 out of 5 stars (but 5 out of 5 for a memorable experience in the realm of the absurd)
reviews.author: Oliver

reviews.title: Very bad staff
reviews.text: My gf and me were the first to board, they decided to take the suit case of my gf even though the we were and the flight was absolutely empty. We explained that there is a space for the small suit case which we are allowed to take but the people are very rude and stupid
reviews.author: Hussam A

reviews.title: Good but conflicted
reviews.text: I understand some of the negative reviews and do not necessarily believe them to be inaccurate. This review will combine the long-haul flight and the short hop that followed it, one good and one not so good. The long-haul flight I found to be on par with United level service. The only area that was negative on the long-haul flight was the attempt to receive assistance from the flight attendants which was way more difficult than it needed to be. The layover in Lisbon was an adventure and here the indifference of the TAP personnel were lacking at a whole new level. Attempted to approach several TAP employees who would walk away before the question could be asked or not answer questions in general. Was unable to obtain any information on the connecting flight until 30 minutes prior to departure. This is unsatisfactory. The short haul flight itself was one of the worst experiences from boarding, flight itself and landing. The landing was so hard it was bone jarring. At the baggage claim it was discovered that one of the suitcases was severely damaged. I would use them again as I see their problems as no different than any other airline.
